export.title: Export Options
exportv2.action_tip: Withhold: the row is left out. Redact: the row is kept and the columns you pick are blanked. Ignore: the tag has no effect. A row with any Withhold tag is withheld.
exportv2.check_copies: Copies of these rows in other artifacts are checked next
exportv2.check_media: Media shared with kept rows is checked next
exportv2.check_note: The case note will be visible to the reviewer
exportv2.check_paths_off: Run log and source paths are left out
exportv2.check_paths_on: Run log or source paths are included
exportv2.copies_line_one: {{count}} kept row has the same text as a withheld row.
exportv2.copies_line_other: {{count}} kept rows have the same text as a withheld row.
exportv2.format_tip: A LAVA project reopens in LAVA with media and provenance. An HTML report is one file for quick review or case notes.
exportv2.include_logs_tip: These list source file paths, which can name privileged files. Device info is always included.
exportv2.include_paths_tip: The case folder name, the source .lava path and the LEAPP input, output and profile paths. Folder names can name a client or an attorney.
exportv2.label: Production label
exportv2.label_tip: Optional, for example Release 1. Shown to whoever opens the export.
exportv2.mode_exclude_line: Withhold privileged rows from a reviewer.
exportv2.note_tip: Stored in the export and shown to whoever opens it.
exportv2.redact_tip: Text cells read [REDACTED]. Other cells and media are left empty. The original values are never written to the export.
exportv2.replaces_tip: Pick the earlier export this one replaces. It must come from the same database. The rows to claw back are listed in your filter records.
exportv2.shared_line_one: {{count}} media file is also used by rows you are keeping.
exportv2.shared_line_other: {{count}} media files are also used by rows you are keeping.
filter.condition_help: Text matches ignore ASCII letter case. With wildcards enabled, * matches any text and ? matches one character. Use \* or \? for literal symbols and \\ for a literal backslash. Negative text conditions exclude blanks.
filter.no_date_data: There is no date data in this column to filter on.
meta.artifact.author: Author
meta.artifact.name: Artifact Name
meta.module.name: Module Name
no_artifact_selected: No artifact selected. Please choose one from the list on the left.
processed_files.schema_error_detail: This report has an incomplete processed-files database schema.
qc.export_note: In a withhold export this tag defaults to Ignore. Retag any privileged rows you find with your privilege tag.
qc.intro: Picks rows that carry no tag, so you can check rows no term or tag caught. Each artifact gets its share of the sample. The seed and counts go in the tag note and your filter records.
qc.line: Tag a random sample of untagged rows to check by hand.
qc.min_tip: Every artifact with untagged rows gets at least this many, so small artifacts are not skipped.
qc.nothing_to_sample: There are no untagged rows to sample
qc.record_failed: The sample was tagged but its record could not be saved
qc.seed_tip: The same seed draws the same rows again.
qc.tag_note: QC sample: seed {{seed}}, {{sampled}} of {{population}} untagged rows (requested {{requested}}, minimum {{min}} per artifact).
qc.title: QC sample of untagged rows
save_ui_state.tooltip.manual: Click to manually save UI state
search.add_examples: Add example terms from a federal filter protocol
search.empty_lists: Enter attorney and generic terms, then search.
search.empty_simple: Search every column of every artifact.
search.list_attorney_placeholder:
Jane Smith
jsmith@examplelaw.com
(555) 123-4567
Example Law Group
search.list_attorney_tip: Lawyer names, email addresses, phone numbers, law firm names. Hits are presumed privileged. One term per line.
search.list_generic_tip: Words like attorney or legal advice. Hits are for review. One term per line.
search.matching_tip: Finds rows where any column contains a term, ignoring case for A-Z. A term of 7 or more digits matches phone numbers in any format: (555) 123-4567 also finds +15551234567. Media file names count too.
search.no_hits: No artifact has a matching row
search.placeholder: Type a term and press Enter. Add as many as you need.
search.recorded: The terms and the tagged rows were recorded in the case's filter records.
search.report_failed: The search report could not be saved
search.review_note: Term hits are a starting point. A hit can be a business conversation, and privileged rows can miss every term. Review the tagged rows before you export.
search.time_window_changed: The time window has changed since this search ran. Run it again to match it.
search.time_window_run: Searched only the rows inside the time window: {{range}}
search.time_window_untimed_one: {{count}} artifact with hits has no timestamp column and was searched in full.
search.time_window_untimed_other: {{count}} artifacts with hits have no timestamp column and were searched in full.
search.title: Find in all artifacts
subset.integrity_excluded_mismatches: Examiner excluded mismatched rows ({{mismatch}} mismatch, {{missing}} missing)
subset.integrity_included_mismatches: Examiner included mismatched rows ({{mismatch}} mismatch, {{missing}} missing)
subset.integrity_passed: All tags matched row content at export time
subset.integrity_passed_with_missing: All present tags matched row content; {{missing}} missing row(s) omitted
subset.processed_files_note_filtered: Showing files for the artifacts included in this subset.
subset.processed_files_note_full: Showing the full original run's file index.
subset.redaction_value_one: {{count}} row kept with cells redacted (text reads {{marker}}, other cells empty). These rows differ from the source.
subset.redaction_value_other: {{count}} rows kept with cells redacted (text reads {{marker}}, other cells empty). These rows differ from the source.
subset.withheld_rows_value_one: {{count}} tagged row withheld from this subset
subset.withheld_rows_value_other: {{count}} tagged rows withheld from this subset
tags.convo_pdf_intro: One PDF per conversation, holding only the tagged messages. Untagged messages show as filtered gaps and the header records the filter.
tags.convo_pdf_none: No tagged rows belong to an artifact with a conversation view.
tags.delete_confirm_body_one: This removes the tag from {{count}} row. Evidence data is not modified.
tags.delete_confirm_body_other: This removes the tag from {{count}} rows. Evidence data is not modified.
tags.delete_confirm_notes_one: It is the only tag on {{count}} row with an examiner note — that note will be deleted too.
tags.delete_confirm_notes_other: It is the only tag on {{count}} rows with examiner notes — those notes will be deleted too.
tags.edit_tags_tooltip: Click to add or remove tags
tags.error_name_duplicate: A tag with this name already exists
tags.export_copies_common_one: {{count}} common value was not offered: it matches more than {{limit}} kept rows
tags.export_copies_common_other: {{count}} common values were not offered: each matches more than {{limit}} kept rows
tags.export_copies_intro: Each of these kept rows holds a text of {{min}} or more characters that is exactly the text of a cell in a withheld or redacted row. They go to the reviewer unless they are tagged too. Text inside a longer cell is not found. For each checked artifact, its copies get the tag and are withheld, then the check runs again.
tags.export_done_compare: Compared with the export it replaces: {{removed}} rows removed and {{changed}} rows changed (claw these back), {{added}} rows added
tags.export_done_copies_one: {{count}} kept row has the same text as a withheld row. It is listed in the filter records.
tags.export_done_copies_other: {{count}} kept rows have the same text as a withheld row. They are listed in the filter records.
tags.export_done_records_failed: The export was written but its filter-team records were not: {{error}}
tags.export_done_shared_media_one: {{count}} media file pointed to by a withheld row is in the export because a kept row also points to it.
tags.export_done_shared_media_other: {{count}} media files pointed to by withheld rows are in the export because kept rows also point to them.
tags.export_exclude_warning_copies: The same content can sit in other artifacts (another message table, a recovered or deleted-record artifact, a timeline). After you click Export, LAVA lists kept rows whose text matches a withheld row exactly, so you can tag them too. Text inside a longer cell is not found.
tags.export_exclude_warning_logs: The run log and processed-files index list source file paths, which can name privileged files. They are off by default, as are the source folder name and paths.
tags.export_exclude_warning_media: A media file stays in the export when any kept row points to it, even if a withheld row points to it as well. Export lists those files first so you can tag their kept rows too.
tags.export_exclude_warning_note: The case note below is shown to whoever opens the export.
tags.export_fingerprint_exclude_mode_int: The artifact database has changed since tags were saved. Rows that were never reviewed for tagging could reach the reviewer, so this export cannot continue. Re-check the tags against the current database, then export again.
tags.export_mismatch_exclude_disabled: No rows still match their tags — exclude would export nothing.
tags.export_mismatch_exclude_mode_intro: Some tagged rows no longer match their content when they were tagged, or are missing. When withholding rows this export cannot continue, because the withheld content may now be in a different row. Re-check and re-tag these rows, then export again.
tags.export_mismatch_include_disabled: No rows remain to export — every tagged row is missing.
tags.export_mismatch_intro: Some tagged rows no longer match the content when they were tagged. This export can continue by including or excluding the mismatched rows.
tags.export_mismatch_missing_note: Missing rows cannot be exported and are always skipped.
tags.export_mismatch_missing_only_note: No tag/content mismatches — only missing rows. Continuing exports the rows that are still present.
tags.export_needs_review_one: {{count}} row still carries a Needs review tag. Retag it as privileged or remove the tag before a withhold export.
tags.export_needs_review_other: {{count}} rows still carry a Needs review tag. Retag them as privileged or remove the tag before a withhold export.
tags.export_redact_columns_required: Choose at least one column to redact for each artifact with redacted rows
tags.export_shared_intro_one: {{count}} media file is pointed to by a withheld row and by rows that will be kept. It goes to the reviewer with the kept rows unless they are tagged too. For each checked file, its kept rows get the tag and are withheld, then the check runs again.
tags.export_shared_intro_other: {{count}} media files are pointed to by withheld rows and by rows that will be kept. They go to the reviewer with the kept rows unless those rows are tagged too. For each checked file, its kept rows get the tag and are withheld, then the check runs again.
tags.export_shared_no_withhold_tag: No selected tag is set to withhold, so these rows cannot be tagged from here. Set a tag to withhold, or export without tagging.
tags.export_stage_copies_check: Checking for copies of withheld rows
tags.export_stage_shared_check: Checking for media shared with withheld rows
tags.export_supersedes_not_subset: That file is not a LAVA subset export
tags.export_supersedes_source_mismatch: The export it replaces was made from a different artifact database (its source SHA-256 does not match). Rows can only be compared within one source.
tags.export_type_html_media_note: For large amounts of media, the subset project is recommended.
tags.fingerprint_warning_body: The artifact database has changed since tags were saved. Tagged rows may no longer match their original content.
tags.newer_version_body: This project's tags file was created by a newer version of LAVA. Tags are read-only to avoid data loss.
tags.newer_version_title: Tags file from a newer LAVA
tags.no_tagged_rows: No tagged rows yet. Select rows in an artifact table and apply a tag.
tags.note_loss_confirm_body_one: Removing the last tag from this row will also delete its examiner note. Notes cannot exist without a tag.
tags.note_loss_confirm_body_other: Removing the last tag from {{count}} rows will also delete their examiner notes. Notes cannot exist without a tag.
tags.note_requires_tag: Add a tag first — notes belong to tagged rows and are removed with the last tag.
tags.readonly_tooltip: Project folder is not writable — tagging is disabled
tags.role_tip: What the tag is for. In a withhold export, Privileged and No role default to Withhold, QC sample defaults to Ignore, and Needs review stops the export until its rows are retagged or untagged.
tags.select_all_failed: Could not select the matching rows
time_window.category_tooltip: {{category}} ({{artifacts}}; {{total_records}} in the time window, plus the full count of any artifact with no timestamp column)
time_window.help: Shows only the rows whose time falls in this range in every artifact table, count, conversation list and Find in all artifacts. Inside a conversation, messages outside the range fold into filtered-out markers. Rows with no time in the tested column drop out. Tagged rows, tag exports and the QC sample still cover the whole case.
time_window.hide_untimed_tip: Artifacts with no timestamp column are shown in full while the window is on. Tick this to show none of their rows instead.
time_window.mode_any: Keep a row when any of its timestamp columns falls in the range
time_window.mode_first: Use each artifact's first timestamp column (its event time)
time_window.summary: Applies to every artifact. Times in {{timezone}}.
time_window.tagged_rows_note: The time window does not apply here. Tagged rows, their exports and the QC sample cover the whole case.
time_window.title: Time window
time_window.untimed_note: This artifact has no timestamp column, so the time window does not filter it. Every row is shown.
time_window.untimed_short: No timestamp column: not filtered by time.
time_window.untimed_tooltip: {{name}} has no timestamp column, so the time window does not filter it ({{records}})
zodiac.chinese.tooltip: Based on the Gregorian year. Dates from Jan 21–Feb 20 may fall before or after Chinese New Year, so both animals are shown.
zodiac.western.tooltip: Tropical western signs. Dates within ±2 days of a sign boundary are marked maybe because cusp dates vary by source.
